# later jobs, because every job reads its configuration from its own base commit.

[athena]
schema = 1

[models]
# The reader turns a request into a reading; it picks the producer from `producer_allowed`.
reader = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
producer_default = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
producer_allowed = ["claude-haiku-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5"]
# The verifier must never be a model that can produce (nothing verifies its own work).
verifier = "claude-opus-5-5"
# The effort level each role runs at (Claude Code's `--effort`: low, medium, high, xhigh or max). Every
# invocation record names the model and effort it ran with.
reader_effort = "medium"
producer_effort = "medium"
verifier_effort = "high"
# A reading that judges its job hard (for example one that changes landing, the history check or records)
# gives the producer this model and effort instead, and records why. The model must be in `producer_allowed`:
# the verifier's model may not produce, so the stronger setting is a higher effort on the stronger allowed model.
hard_producer_model = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
hard_producer_effort = "high"

[models.names]
# Display names, used in Co-Authored-By trailers on landing commits.
"claude-opus-5-5" = "Claude Opus 5.5"
"claude-sonnet-5-5" = "Claude Sonnet 5.5"
"claude-haiku-5-5" = "Claude Haiku 5.5"

[budget]
reader_usd = 2.00
producer_usd = 10.00
verifier_usd = 5.00
job_usd = 50.00
max_readings = 5
reader_timeout_s = 300
producer_timeout_s = 5400
verifier_timeout_s = 3600
check_timeout_s = 1800
# The longest the checks stage waits for the CI run of the candidate (read every 20 seconds) before it runs
# the checks locally.
ci_wait_s = 1500

[agents]
# The worker is held constant: Claude Code at this version (see D03).
claude_version = "2.1.302"
# Agents start with an empty environment. These variables are always passed.
env_pass = ["HOME", "PATH"]
# These are passed only when set: locale and user, toolchain locations, Claude Code's own credentials and
# endpoint, GitHub credentials for the steward's read-only `gh` (D96), and the machine's network settings
# (proxies and certificate bundles).

    "LANG", "LC_ALL", "LC_CTYPE", "TMPDIR", "USER", "LOGNAME", "TERM", "TZ",
    "RUSTUP_HOME", "CARGO_HOME",
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL",

    "NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS", "SSL_CERT_FILE", "SSL_CERT_DIR", "CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO",

bash_max_timeout_ms = 1200000

# The verifier never writes: the hook allows its `cargo fmt` only with `--check`.
verifier_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"] }

[capabilities.change.env]
# Each job builds in its own directories, one per side (D46). {job_dir} and {side} are filled in by Athena.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR = "{job_dir}/target/{side}"
CARGO_TERM_COLOR = "never"

name = "fmt"
run = ["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--check"]

skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"]

name = "clippy"
run = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--locked", "--", "-D", "warnings"]
skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"]

# file, .md files included, so a prose change can fail a test.

kind = "test"
run = ["cargo", "test", "--locked"]

repo_ref = "main"
producer_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree", "doc"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"], rm = ["*"], mv = ["*"], chmod = ["*"] }
verifier_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"] }

[capabilities.study.env]
CARGO_TARGET_DIR = "{job_dir}/target/{side}"
CARGO_TERM_COLOR = "never"

name = "fmt"
run = ["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--check"]

[[capabilities.study.checks]]
name = "clippy"
run = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--locked", "--", "-D", "warnings"]

kind = "test"
run = ["cargo", "test", "--locked"]

p_user_intervenes = 0.2

# commit's content skips the invariant, and its jobs' own records still get the per-record checks.
# f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 is the squash of PR #9. Most of that PR's jobs predate
# athena.candidate/2, so the chain landing rule (D69) cannot link them (D70).

# history check, records, the run pipeline or the drain. Every other job runs the producer and verifier only.
# `mode = "all"` plans every change job. `enabled = false` turns planning off whatever the mode (D110, D143).
[job_plan]
enabled = true
mode = "hard"
planner_usd = 3.00
critic_usd = 3.00
planner_timeout_s = 600
critic_timeout_s = 600
max_rounds = 5
"
